image_description: A male black grouse (blackcock) standing in a grassy field. The bird displays glossy black plumage with iridescent blue-green sheen on the neck and breast, prominent red eyebrow combs (caruncles), and a short curved beak. White wing bars are visible, and the tail shows the characteristic lyre shape with white undertail coverts partially visible. The legs appear feathered.
